params.body:
> **Vision preview: describes capabilities that are partly not built yet (listed below). Not meant for production until the owner decides.**

## What

The home page and the trader page now tell where Stocklist Dealer is going, in Dutch, French and English, reusing the existing sections and the dark Stocklist Dealer identity from `site.css` and `Logo.astro`.

Home, top to bottom:

1. **Hero**: sell more cars than you have on your lot; the network, your own site, and everything a customer does lands in Stocklist. The stock mock now shows "sold by colleagues" price advice and bids from your own traders.
2. **The network** (`#netwerk`): six benefits. Share stock, sell a colleague's car under your name and margin (customer mode), buy in one click with automatic take-down, price advice from real sold prices, closed bidding among your own traders, ratings between garages.
3. **Your own website is the front door** (`#website`): why a marketplace makes a garage interchangeable, why its own site does not, no iframe. Drawn mock of a neutral garage site ("your garage", a style that belongs to no real garage) with a test drive landing in Stocklist.
4. **From site to sale** (new `flow` section): question to lead, test drive to appointment plus prefilled agreement, monthly price to FlexLease, warranty to RealGarant, trade-in to a purchase put to your traders, buying to offer, order form, deposit, delivery and invoice. Plus the other direction: change it in Stocklist and the site follows.
5. **Websites in steps** (`#websites`): ready to start (logo, colour, photos, AI texts), in your own style, fully custom premium, a brand first. The garage never configures design itself.
6. **Plus: send a car**: drawn mock of the mail a customer or colleague receives.
7. **Packages** (`#pakketten`): Stocklist and Stocklist Plus, both "on request". No price was ever published on the live site, so none is published here.
8. **Feature overview** (new `featureTable` section, `#functies`): rows live in `src/data/features.ts`, one row per feature with all three languages on one line, cells `true`, `false` or `'option'`. Adding a feature or a package is one edit there; the market-comparison findings can be added the same way.

Removed from the home page because none of it had a source: the stats band (1.200+, 150+, 21 days), the placeholder testimonials ("Naam volgt") and the trust bar, as well as the 2022 video and the old feature cards (their content is in the overview now).

Trader page: new hero and copy (closed bidding, the full sheet, ratings, transport paid online, four steps), the 2022 "free access" promotion and the 21-day claim are gone; the existing screenshots stay, without their fake numbering.

Navigation: Home, Network, Your website, Packages, Traders, Blog, Contact, Login (Reviews and the duplicate Register link pointed at sections that no longer exist).

## Not built yet (described as if it exists)

- The garage website engine as the front door: the garage's own site run by Stocklist, network stock under its name, no iframe (today: iframe module and public API).
- Websites in steps as a service: ready-made site with AI texts, own style, premium custom site, brand definition.
- Online test-drive booking from the site, creating an appointment and a prefilled test-drive agreement.
- Lead pipeline: status, owner, follow-up (Plus).
- Trade-in valuation for site visitors, put to your own traders in one click (Plus).
- Send a car by mail with a preview (Plus).
- Dealer reports: days in stock, margin, lead to sale (Plus).
- Invoice through Peppol straight from the order form.
- Price advice on the car sheet from colleagues' real sold prices ("similar cars sold for X in Y days"), as drawn in the stock mock.
- Deposit link on offer or order through online payment.
- A link to an existing workshop or accounting package (shown as "option").
- The Stocklist Plus package itself, and which features belong to it: the split in `features.ts` is a proposal to be decided.

Already there and described as such: stock with VIN lookup, photos with plate blurring and background removal, Car-Pass, publishing to listing sites with take-down on sale, customer mode, one-click buy from a colleague, ratings, closed bidding, showroom screen and price card, AI descriptions, users, roles and locations, leasing through FlexLease and warranty through RealGarant on offers and orders, transport with online payment, public API.

## Craft

- House-style fixes that touch every page: kickers and the plan flag in sentence case instead of spaced capitals, the bullet marker is a short bar instead of an em dash, footer and mocks use punctuation instead of middle dots and dashes. Rendered home and trader pages contain no em dash, middle dot or TODO.
- Six cards render as two rows of three and four as one row (two on tablet) instead of leaving an orphan row; the mobile menu now starts below 1140px because eight links no longer fit next to the button.
- The mocks are HTML and CSS, `aria-hidden`, with their words inside the component per language.
- Not done: the Sanity studio schema does not know the `flow` and `featureTable` sections yet (Sanity is not wired up, the build reads the local JSON), and the design canvas in `docs/design/` does not show the new sections.

## Checks

`npm ci`, `npm run check` (0 errors, 0 warnings) and `npm run build` (31 pages) pass. Looked at in a browser at 390px (French home: no horizontal scroll), 1000px, 1150px and 1360px (Dutch home, French trader page).
params.title: Vision preview: the network, the garage's own site as front door, and Stocklist Plus
